machining.issue: box walls X+-22 coincide with ring bore D44: the box root lands on the ring only where r>=22 (corners and Z<-22); top/side walls sit over the bore -> FE root fix at Y0 is non-conservative
machining.fix: box root fillet R3 into a 3 mm root land; or reduce bore to D36 under the box (keeps M4 at PCD62, hub ID54 unaffected since bore only needs clearance) - Arms picks bore D36
